## 13c2bb6fb5a7

**A13-1 — reproduced border-support shortcut; audited source left unchanged.**
Generator SHA-256 is
`a3b7f791f66cad710cfc521fd643c1dfee4eb7f29f8884435b3681f700d4b5da`;
executed rule hash is `88475e062f41`.

The generator always leaves at least one zero cell between every nonzero object
and the outer border. All five canonical labeled pairs have the same one-cell
border. A rival can therefore erase the input's outermost row and column cells,
then crop to the remaining nonzero bounding box. It fit 5/5 canonical pairs and
6,000/6,000 ordinary generated draws (seeds 0..99, indices 0..19, easy/medium/hard).
No generated draw placed a nonzero cell on an outer edge.

A lawful 6x6 counterexample places a color-1 L at the top-left border and a
color-2 L in the interior. `self_check` returns `[]`. The selected Racket rule
crops and preserves both objects as a 4x5 output; the border-erasing rival drops
the first object and returns only the 2x2 interior crop. Evidence:

- `checks/audit/13c2bb6fb5a7/shortcut/comparison.json` — exact input, outputs,
  19 differing aligned cells, canonical and 6,000-draw counts, source/rule hashes;
- `checks/audit/13c2bb6fb5a7/shortcut/input.json` — reproducer input;
- `checks/audit/13c2bb6fb5a7/shortcut/racket.json` — supported selected-Racket receipt;
- `checks/audit/13c2bb6fb5a7/shortcut/probe.py` — reusable census and rival.

Assessment: this is a teaching-distribution gap. A repair should generate
validator-lawful edge-touching scenes and declare the border-erasing rival. The
strict audit battery separately reported 6 green and 6 failed stages (lint,
defect lint, profile floor, semantic contract, overrides, and authority sync);
those broader maintenance failures are retained in
`checks/audit/13c2bb6fb5a7/battery/` but are not themselves proof of A13-1. No
source file for this audit target was edited.
